{{Top|leg}}
'''Lessen injury''' was a [[Ta-Ree]] spell capable of being wielded by [[Ascendant (Kathol)|Ascendants]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kathol (planet)|Kathol]]. The spell allowed the caster to reduce the severity on an injury they had sustained.

Ascendants who wished to cast the spell were required to know the [[block pain]] spell.
